paragraphs: From Carnmore Test Centre take a sharp left onto the unnamed local road and follow it for around 800 metres.
At the roundabout take the 1st exit left onto the R381.
At the mini roundabout take the slight left exit onto the R381.
At the next roundabout exit left to stay on the connecting road.
Follow this road for close to 2 kilometres until you reach a larger roundabout on the R381.
Go straight through the roundabout.
At the next roundabout take the slight left exit onto the R338.
Stay on the R338 for about 750 metres.
Turn left onto Main Street and continue for around 350 metres.
Take the 1st right onto the unnamed road.
Take the next right into Bluebell Woods estate.
Drive slowly around the housing loop, keeping left and then right as the road bends.
Leaving Bluebell Woods continue right and at the end of the road turn right onto the L4101.
Take the next left onto Oranhill Road.
Turn right into Oranview and practice your turnabout using the U-turn manoeuvre.
At the end of Oranview turn left back onto Oranhill Road.
Turn right onto the unnamed link road.
Turn right onto the L4101.
Turn right again onto Main Street and at the end of the road turn left.
Take the slight left at Oranbeg Roundabout and continue straight onto the main road.
Retrace your path through the roundabouts on the R381.
Watch for the sharp right onto a quiet stretch where you may practice another U-turn.
Take the sharp left back onto the R381.
Work your way through the roundabouts once more.
Follow the slight left off-ramp and turn left for the final approach back to the Carnmore test centre.
